use_case_summary: Primary workload: document search for legal teams. Pipeline: ingest -> embeddings -> vector DB -> candidate retrieval -> reranking with smaller generation model. Latency target: <300ms tail for retrieval+rerank in common query paths (startup target), happy with async heavier paths for detailed citations. Throughput: low-medium (50-200 qps peak for small firm network). Cost sensitivity: high; prefer hosted API but need clear unit economics and recommended caching/batching. Model preferences: open models accepted; prefer 7B-13B family for reranker if quality/cost tradeoff is good. Routing: want fallback to cheaper model when load spikes. Security: SSO for team, audit logs for queries, and ability to mark EU-only docs for residency control.
